summary: Microphone redo icon and expanded parcel tracking

changes.title: More parcel carriers
changes.detail: Recognize explicitly labelled FedEx, DHL Express, Blue Dart and Delhivery tracking numbers; preserve distinctive UPS recognition. Explicit taps open official carrier destinations. DHL and Delhivery open their tracking forms without speculative prefill.

changes.title: Microphone and redo recovery icon
changes.detail: Failed transcription retry or reinsertion uses a single microphone-plus-redo glyph in the same animated contextual slot as Chrome.
